decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 4 - That the external fair face brick is to remain unpainted, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - That the segmented arched heads and widths of former openings of the flank wall remain.

Condition : 6 - Informative: 
It would be preferential to have fixed lights (no mullions) to the slot windows - chunky profile ok to big doors, slender cames to the slots.

Condition : 7 - It is considered that the proposed single storey side extension because of its position, design and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of the Listed Building, and is complimentary to character and visual appearance of the conservation area and would not be detrimental to the residential amenity of the adjoining dwellings. The development is considered to be in accordance with Policies ENV B.1.1 (New Development), ENV B.2.2 (Conservation Areas), ENV B.2.5	(Development Affecting the Setting of a Listed Building), ENV B.2.7	(Alterations to Listed Buildings and Buildings of Local Townscape Character) and H.6.4 (Alterations and Extensions) of the Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 and 'The Butts Conservation Area' planning guidelines as outlined in the UDP Supplementary Planning Guidelines.
description: Erection of a single storey side extension to existing dwellinghouse. (Listed Building)
